# Held-out exercises for software-quality, written without reading the skill.
#
# In each, the obvious change passes the project's own tests and breaks something
# a reviewer would flag, and the fixture says enough to see it. The format and the
# verifier encoding are those of exercises.txt.

# The function that lists what is due also marks entries and queues mail to their
# owners, so a preview built on it is not a preview.
[sweep-dry-run] Add a --dry-run flag to sweep.py that prints which uploads a run for that date would remove, so I can check the list before cron gets to it. | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Installed hosts keep their own ini file and service unit across upgrades, so a
# plain rename silently returns them to the default. Reading the old name, or
# refusing it with a message that names the new one, both pass.
[setting-rename] People keep guessing the unit of the timeout setting. Rename it to timeout_seconds. | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
